title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Data Lead
description:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm and raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B in its latest funding round. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our data team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.

For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


About the Role:

We’re seeking a highly motivated, team-oriented Data Lead to drive data strategy and execution across a best-in-class portfolio of data products. In this role, you’ll report to our Head of Data and split your time between owning challenging analytical work and guiding a team of data analysts to build and deliver top-tier data products.

This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, collaboration, and delivering measurable value. Those with strong analytical skills who are excited to lead teams, build and optimize data workflows, and partner cross-functionally to shape and execute on product strategy are encouraged to apply.


As a Data Lead, You Will:

  • Own data strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-impact data products for investors , driving product success through a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency and partnering closely with research and commercial leaders to set and hit ambitious targets
  • Operate as a player-coach , setting a high bar for quality, speed, and innovation while coaching, empowering, and inspiring your team to do their best work.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer investor key questions about the sectors we cover and datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Tackle complex data problems, using your analytical skills to optimize methodologies, test new datasets, and solve data-related problems that require innovative solutions
  • Drive standardization, simplification, and improvements to our data pipelines and workflows to minimize risk and maximize efficiency and value
  • Partner cross-functionally with other teams including Research and Engineering to uncover and execute on opportunities to further drive customer value and optimize our processes and pipelines


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, forecasting, or business intelligence, including 1-2 years in a management or lead capacity
  • You have 3+ years of experience working with SQL, Python, Pyspark, or other programming languages to explore and transform large, complex datasets; Proficiency with Github and familiarity with Databricks
  • You have strong communication skills and are able to work and project manage effectively with stakeholders across both technical and non-technical teams
  • You excel at approaching complex problems logically and decisively, and take pride in implementing scalable solutions
  • You have a strong ownership and entrepreneurial mentality and are enthusiastic about working with others to make a big impact
  • Preferred: You’ve worked in or alongside capital markets, investment research, or financial services.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior UX Writer
description:
Como UX Writer na área de ERP Soluções, você terá um papel estratégico na evolução da prática de conteúdo dentro da Sankhya, atuando em parceria com designers, tech writers e product managers.


Sua missão será estruturar e escalar processos de escrita em interfaces complexas (como ERPs), contribuindo diretamente para a redução de fricções, a melhoria da experiência do usuário e a otimização de resultados de negócio.


Se você tem experiência com UX Writing em softwares de gestão ou sistemas digitais robustos e deseja apoiar a construção de uma disciplina de conteúdo orientada a métricas e resultados, essa vaga é para você!



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Criar, revisar e evoluir conteúdos de interface dos produtos Sankhya, garantindo clareza, consistência e aderência ao Design System e Content System .


  • Atuar na implementação e manutenção de processos de Content Ops , incluindo métricas, indicadores e fluxos de governança.


  • Conduzir iniciativas de padronização e revisão do legado textual em sistemas ERP.


  • Aplicar boas práticas de UX Writing para interfaces complexas, orientando times de produto sobre microcopy, fluxos de erro, onboarding, mensagens de sistema, notificações e tutoriais em produto.


  • Utilizar Figma para criação, iteração e documentação de componentes de conteúdo junto com designers.


  • Colaborar com tech writers, designers e engenheiros para integrar a estratégia de conteúdo em diferentes pontos da jornada do usuário.


  • Acompanhar métricas de experiência (ex.: NPS, CSAT, deflection de tickets, engajamento em produto) para validar o impacto das soluções de conteúdo.


  • Conduzir workshops e dinâmicas de alinhamento para difundir boas práticas de conteúdo em toda a empresa.




REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Graduação em Letras, Design, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência comprovada como UX Writer, preferencialmente em sistemas ERP, SaaS ou plataformas de software complexas.


  • Conhecimento em Content Ops , incluindo métricas, governança e processos de escalabilidade de conteúdo.


  • Domínio de ferramentas de design e prototipação como Figma .


  • Capacidade de estruturar e manter Content Systems integrados ao Design System.


  • Excelente domínio da língua portuguesa, com foco em clareza, concisão e consistência textual.


  • Familiaridade com documentação técnica de produto (ex.: guias, manuais, help centers, integrações, APIs).


  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas (Design, Produto, Engenharia, Service Desk).



Diferenciais (Desejável)


  • Experiência em ERP ou softwares de gestão empresarial .


  • Vivência com métricas de conteúdo e frameworks de análise.


  • Conhecimento em IA aplicada a conteúdo (prompt design, otimização para copilotos e assistentes virtuais).


  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).




Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Senior Flutter Developer

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior


We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio/video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Flutter Developer focused on macOS Desktop to build and evolve our desktop client. You’ll ship a high-performance, stable, and well-instrumented app that integrates video/audio, real-time features, and collaborative tools—while keeping top-tier code quality, testing, and documentation.

Secondary scope: help maintain Android and iOS builds (feature parity, fixes, and releases).


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain the Flutter macOS app with clean architecture, modular layers, and reliable state management .
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and real-time services (e.g., WebSockets/Streams ).
  • Implement A/V features (e.g., flutter_webrtc): device selection, camera/mic permissions, I/O routing, and stability under variable networks.
  • Ensure observability end to end: instrument product events/metrics; triage errors with Sentry ; capture UX signals with Microsoft Clarity (session replay/heatmaps) where applicable (web/embedded views); analyze performance traces and dashboards.
  • Own quality : unit, widget, and integration tests; CI checks; code reviews; technical docs.
  • Handle macOS distribution : code signing & notarization , entitlements, Hardened Runtime , App Sandbox , Keychain; package DMG/PKG ; manage auto-update (e.g., Sparkle).
  • Collaborate with Product/Design/QA to refine requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria; keep specs tidy in Confluence and PRs clear.
  • Team rituals & reporting:
  • Attend daily standups in English and other ceremonies (planning, grooming, demos, retros).
  • Keep Jira up to date (status, links, attachments) and log time entries (work logs) per task.
  • Submit an end-of-day (EOD) daily report in English including: hours worked (per task), what was completed, current task & ETA, blockers, and plan for tomorrow.
  • Secondary (Android & iOS): maintain parity when applicable, fix platform-specific issues, help with CI/CD and store releases , monitor crashes/perf via Sentry and review UX insights with Clarity when relevant.


CPU & GPU Optimizations (primary focus)

CPU

  • Minimize rebuilds: effective state selection (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider), const constructors, proper Keys , split large widgets.
  • Cut redundant layout/work: avoid heavy logic in build, cache computed values, reduce intrinsic measurements, coalesce events, debounce/throttle streams.
  • Move heavy tasks off the UI thread: isolates (compute/custom), lazy JSON parsing, incremental work units.
  • Frame scheduling discipline: prevent setState loops; render only when state actually changes.

GPU

  • Reduce overdraw/repaints : place RepaintBoundary wisely; optimize CustomPainter (shouldRepaint); avoid large Opacity on complex subtrees.
  • Avoid expensive effects: minimize saveLayer , heavy blurs/gradients and big shadows .
  • Use right-sized images & filterQuality (low/none when acceptable); limit transforms on large layers.
  • Shader jank control: warm up shaders / capture SkSL where applicable; keep fragment shaders simple.
  • Pause/disable animations when off-screen; keep animation count/area minimal.


Measurement & Guardrails:

  • Profile with Flutter DevTools (CPU/GPU/frame timeline) and add perf budgets (avg CPU%/GPU frame time) to CI gates.
  • Track before/after metrics per feature; regressions must be fixed before release.


Must-Haves

  • Fluent English (spoken and written): comfortable in daily English standups and writing EOD reports.
  • Strong experience with Flutter and Dart building Desktop apps (preferably macOS ).
  • Proven work reducing CPU/GPU usage in Flutter apps (ideally desktop/macOS) with measurable before/after results.
  • Solid grasp of architectural patterns (MVC/MVVM/Clean ), DI , and state management (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider).
  • Hands-on with RESTful APIs , WebSockets/Streams , async/isolates , and robust error handling.
  • Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Analytics) or equivalent , Microsoft Clarity (for UX/session insights in web-embedded contexts), and Sentry for error/performance monitoring.
  • Git proficiency, code reviews, CI (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI ), and Jira work logs/time tracking .


Nice to Have

  • Deep macOS expertise: signing, notarization , App Sandbox , entitlements, Keychain, packaging, and updater pipelines.
  • Practical WebRTC experience; spatial audio; jitter/latency tuning.
  • Android/iOS publishing (fastlane or equivalent), push notifications, and in-app review flows.
  • Docker , CDN , and networking basics for real-time apps.
  • Accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack) and internationalization.


Benefits & Environment

  • Remote-first, flexible hours, and competitive market range .
  • Fast feedback loops, ownership, and a product with real impact on how teams work every day.
  • Support for learning, events, and continuous improvement.

Você Realizará atendimento de orientação médica telefônica através de uma abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde relativos a diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Executar atividade de coordenação do cuidado, identificando situações com necessidade de encaminhamento à equipe de segunda opinião médica, comunicando-se eficientemente com os pacientes e sendo o interlocutor do caso ao gerente de segunda opinião médica.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO CONCLUÍDA EM MEDICINA DA FAMILIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;

  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).
  • Conhecimento em escrita de testes usando ferramentas como gherkin.
  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The company and our mission:


Zartis is a digital solutions provider working across technology strategy, software engineering and product development.


We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. Our engineering hubs in EMEA and LATAM are full of talented professionals delivering business success and digital improvement across application development, software architecture, CI/CD, business intelligence, QA automation, and new technology integrations.


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on a project in the modern healthcare industry.


The project:


You will be joining the Booking team, contributing to a platform that simplifies healthcare appointment scheduling for millions of patients and providers. In this role, you’ll help shape how key information - such as insurance details - is collected and validated, ensuring a seamless booking journey.


Your work will center on evolving data models, improving system performance, and strengthening the reliability of a high-volume booking system. By collaborating with experienced engineers, you’ll extend and optimize microservices in the booking domain, driving scalability, cost efficiency, and stability. This is an opportunity to apply deep technical expertise while making a meaningful impact in a distributed, innovation-driven environment.


What you will do:


- Building large-scale APIs and microservices, creating frictionless data flows that empower both patients and providers to access care and information in real time.

- Mentoring fellow engineers, supercharging team throughput through robust coding standards, automated workflows, and a culture of continuous improvement.

- Spearheading bold innovation, whether it’s adopting generative AI, exploring emerging data sources, or pioneering architectural strategies that keep the platform ahead in healthcare tech.

- Decomposing complex product challenges to drive sound design decisions.

- Collaborating with an agile team of engineers, product managers, and designers.

- Working with cutting-edge GenAI tools and technology.


What you will bring:


- Inspiration to positively impact the healthcare experience of millions of patients and providers.

- A product-driven mindset with relentless focus on user needs.

- Strong autonomy, accountability, and comfort in a remote-first environment.

- Passion for engineering fundamentals and promoting best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability.

- Commitment to fostering diverse and inclusive teams and culture.

- Entrepreneurial spirit with strong ownership, thriving in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.

- Ability to craft database schemas, implement REST APIs, and design event-driven queue and stream processing systems, ideally with C#, .NET Core, and AWS.

- A history of solid and well-rounded system design skills.

- Leadership by example in testing, deployment, and observability practices.

- Excellent communication skills: able to dive into technical detail with engineers while presenting clear solutions to non-technical audiences.

- Comfort working with distributed teams.

- Experience integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, drive innovation, and maximize productivity.

- 100% Remote Work.

- WFH allowance: Monthly

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
O Desafio


Procuramos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial Sênior apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em soluções escaláveis, com conhecimento consolidado em LLMs e IA. Você será fundamental para projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de IA de ponta, focados em Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PLN) para dados clínicos complexos.


Esperamos que você traga uma visão estratégica sobre IA e MLOps, ajudando a moldar a arquitetura dos nossos produtos e expandir nossos horizontes tecnológicos.


Em um ambiente colaborativo e de equipe enxuta, valorizamos a iniciativa e protagonismo : buscamos pessoas que se sintam confortáveis propondo, liderando e implementando soluções complexas, com um olhar atento à performance, escalabilidade e ética da IA.


Responsabilidades


Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de modelos de IA/LLMs: desde a pesquisa e prototipagem até a implementação em produção e monitoramento contínuo.


Projetar e construir arquiteturas de software escaláveis para hospedar e gerenciar LLMs e outros modelos de IA.


Implementar e otimizar pipelines de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) para garantir a entrega contínua, deployment e monitoramento de modelos.


Desenvolver e otimizar estratégias de Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para LLMs, visando a extração precisa de informações clínicas e a geração de respostas contextuais.


Escrever códigos de forma limpa, escalável, performática e testável, aplicando os melhores padrões de engenharia de software.


Realizar revisões de código de pares, fornecendo feedback construtivo e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Analisar requerimentos de negócio e produto, transformando-os em especificações técnicas e priorizando tarefas de alto impacto.


Atuar como mentor(a) técnico(a) para desenvolvedores e engenheiros de IA mais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e promovendo o crescimento da equipe.


Colaborar ativamente com cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e especialistas de domínio (médicos) para garantir a relevância e eficácia das soluções de IA.


Manter-se atualizado(a) com as últimas pesquisas e avanços em IA, PLN e LLMs, e avaliar a aplicação de novas tecnologias.


Requisitos


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Software ou IA Sênior, com foco em sistemas de IA/ML em produção.


  • Proficiência avançada em Python e experiência com frameworks de ML/DL (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).


  • Conhecimento consolidado e experiência prática com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo técnicas (e.g., Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, RAG) e ferramentas (e.g., Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex).


  • Experiência robusta no desenvolvimento e implantação de pipelines de MLOps e em plataformas de nuvem (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML).


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role

Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure + Elixir + Linux)
description:
DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure • Elixir • Linux )


Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu node network on Microsoft Azure to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.


Your Role and Responsibilities:  


  • Run Besu on Azure: manage validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, and RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.
  • Storage & performance: size and tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB) with Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimize IOPS/throughput, and implement snapshot/restore pipelines via Azure Blob Storage.
  • Networking: build secure, private networking with VNets, subnets, Azure CNI (Cilium), Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute as needed.
  • Traffic & ingress: expose RPC/WS endpoints through Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with Web Application Firewall (WAF), mTLS, rate limits, and IP allowlists.
  • Secrets & keys: manage validator keys and app secrets with Azure Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Microsoft Entra ID.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: ship immutable releases using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, ACR (image signing/scan), Helm, and Argo CD (or Flux) for environment promotion.
  • Observability & SRE: wire up Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana (or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana), OpenTelemetry traces, Alert rules, runbooks, SLOs/error budgets.


Tech You’ll Use:


  • Blockchain: Hyperledger Besu (IBFT/QBFT, permissioning); Geth/Nethermind familiarity is a plus
  • Elixir: Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, OpenTelemetry
  • Azure: AKS, ACR, Azure Monitor & Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana, Key Vault / Managed HSM, Application Gateway/WAF, NAT Gateway, NSG, Private Link, Azure Firewall, Blob Storage, Managed Disks (Premium v2/Ultra), Azure Backup/Site Recovery, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID
  • IaC & CI/CD: Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
  • Logging/Tracing: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK (optional), OpenTelemetry


Essential Qualifications:  


  • 4+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience operating EVM nodes (preferably Besu ) and tuning storage/IO, txpool, and pruning/archive modes.
  • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
  • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).


Who We Are:


DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. JUMP Math is a Canadian-based registered charity and social enterprise with a bold mission to inspire a love of mathematics in students and help them achieve their full potential. Our evidence-based approach and innovative Preschool to Grade 9 resources and pedagogy empowers teachers and students to build confidence, increase engagement, and master essential math skills. If you are passionate about making a real difference and want to contribute to a mission-driven organization that is changing the world, JUMP Math is the place for you.


As a Lead Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for building, reviewing, and maintaining the core systems of the JUMP Math platform. You will ensure that both our application and AI engine are robust, scalable, and maintainable. You will lead and collaborate closely with the engineering team, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and ensuring the team is aligned and effective. You will also work closely with Product and Design to drive the platform forward.


This is a full-time role (37.5 hours/week).


Location of Work: This candidate for this role must be residing in Brazil and is intended to be remote.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Own and deliver high-quality code across the full stack (frontend, backend, and AI integration)
  • Lead and mentor a development team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
  • Conduct code reviews and maintain coding standards to ensure maintainability and reliability
  • Manage DevOps tasks including deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and scaling
  • Design and implement APIs, and integrate with third-party services

Skills:

  • Proficiency in backend languages and frontend frameworks
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, leadership and collaboration skills
  • High level of Spanish and English
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Familiarity with Generative AI (Chat GPT, Prompting, APIs, Fine-tuning) and Machine Learning algorithms (Python)


Personal Attributes:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Proactive and adaptable to a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Commitment to social mission and inclusive education


Education and Experience (minimums):

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with full-stack development
  • Strong experience in DevOps / cloud infrastructure (AWS, CI/CD pipelines)
  • Experience in projects using PHP (Laravel), React.JS, Next.JS
  • Knowledge of data security and regulatory compliance (GDPR, FERPA, or other relevant frameworks)
  • Experience with databases (eg. MySQL, MariaDB, Supabase, MongoDB), caching, and API design
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into production applications
  • Experience leading distributed or remote teams
  • Basic knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive UX practices

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.



WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability



READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.



Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)

A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .

Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

We are seeking a Physics Subject Matter Expert (SME) with exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and writing skills to join our AI/LLM training team .

You will play a crucial role in developing, curating, and evaluating advanced physics content to enhance AI models’ reasoning, accuracy, and ability to explain complex physics concepts.

This role is ideal for physicists, researchers, and academics passionate about science communication and AI innovation.


Key Responsibilities:

Content Development:

  • Conceptual explanations of physics principles (classical, quantum, and modern physics).
  • Problem sets and numerical solutions.
  • Detailed derivations of equations and laws.
  • Technical summaries and scientific research briefs.
  • Build domain-specific datasets across physics subfields such as:
  • Mechanics, Thermodynamics, and Electromagnetism
  • Quantum Mechanics, Particle Physics, and Nuclear Physics
  • Astrophysics, Relativity, and Cosmology
  • Materials Science and Condensed Matter Physics
  • Computational Physics and Applied Physics


Model Evaluation & AI Training:

  • Evaluate LLM-generated physics content for accuracy, clarity, rigor, and logical reasoning.
  • Detect and correct conceptual gaps, numerical errors, and inconsistencies in AI outputs.
  • Help define data quality standards and evaluation rubrics for scientific reasoning.

Collaboration & R&D:

  • Work closely with AI engineers, computational linguists, and data scientists to improve AI reasoning.
  • Provide domain expertise for designing AI benchmarks and test scenarios.
  • Contribute to research on physics education, simulation modeling, and AI-assisted scientific research.


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s or PhD in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline (PhD preferred).
  • Strong foundation in theoretical and applied physics .
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more areas:
  • Computational modeling, simulations, or numerical methods.
  • Advanced topics (e.g., quantum field theory, condensed matter, astrophysics).
  • Proven experience in academic publishing, science communication, or curriculum design .
  • Strong technical writing skills and ability to explain complex concepts clearly .


Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with AI/ML models, data annotation, and prompt engineering (bonus).
  • Experience in LaTeX, Python, or scientific computing tools .
  • Knowledge of AI fairness and bias detection in STEM datasets.


Why Join Innodata?

  • Shape the future of AI by embedding physics expertise into large-scale models.
  • Collaborate with top-tier researchers and engineers globally.
  • Influence next-gen AI capabilities in scientific reasoning.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and innovation-driven teams .

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (React/Golang)
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We’re looking for a driven, resourceful, and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join one of our growing product teams. As a senior member of the team, you will be tasked with designing, building, and enhancing services and user-facing features across our platform, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, scalability, and user experience. You’ll leverage your expertise spanning the entire stack, from database interactions to front-end libraries, contributing significantly to our technical direction and mentoring other engineers.


How you will make an impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable full-stack applications and features across a modern tech stack, including Typescript, React, Go and Postgres.
  • Focus on improving our user experience, collaborating with designers to implement intuitive interfaces and finding creative ways to reduce user pain points.
  • Build and enhance microservices, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and scalability within our distributed systems.
  • Ensure the quality of our products remains high by contributing to automated testing strategies and participating actively in code reviews.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, QA analysts, and other engineers within an Agile development framework.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, identifying and driving improvements in our processes, architecture, and technology stack.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative environment and sharing your expertise.
  • Distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements and robust technical designs.


You may be a good fit for this role if you

  • Are passionate about coding and creating scalable systems and fantastic user experiences.
  • Embrace a growth mindset by continuously questioning established ideas and learning from your experiences.
  • Exhibit humility and a collaborative spirit, fostering a positive work environment while valuing the contributions of others without ego.
  • Value autonomy and empowerment to make your own decisions.


What you will do

During the 1st Month:

  • Attend onboarding sessions to better understand our internal processes and learn about the company
  • Pair with other engineers to learn more about our tech stack, the products we support, and our development standards and processes
  • Familiarize yourself with our automated testing platforms and begin to contribute to our test coverage
  • Collaborate with product team members to implement and ship small features and functionality

Within 3 Months:

  • Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to other engineers
  • Gain exposure to the platform’s underlying infrastructure and deployment processes
  • Understand the high-level architecture of the website and back-end services
  • Begin shipping more complex user-facing code

Within 6 Months:

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Company Description

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.


Position Overview

You’ll be the backbone behind Yuna’s conversational stack—owning services, data, and runtime that make our AI safe, fast, and reliable at scale. You’ll partner with the Staff ML Engineer to turn models into resilient, observable, HIPAA-aware product experiences.


What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and operate services for conversation state, user memory, retrieval, and tool integrations (REST/gRPC).
  • Work closely with clinical psychologists (both internal and external to Yuna), ensuring the efficacy of Yuna’s conversational AI
  • Collaborate with front end teams for API creation, QA, and implementation
  • Implement alignment & safety layers (e.g., self-harm detection, red-teaming, refusal strategies, escalation paths) tuned to clinical guidelines
  • Optimize for latency, cost, and quality
  • Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features and


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years building backend systems in production (Go/Python/NodeJS), with strong systems and API design skills
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, RAG pipelines, and LLMs
  • Cloud infrastructure expertise (Google Cloud Platform)
  • Proficiency with relational + vector/search systems and real-time communication (sockets, WebRTC)
  • Nice to have: Swift (iOS client integration)
  • Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1


Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

Employment Type: Full Time


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (based on experience) + equity options
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility
  • A fast-growing, talented, and empathetic team dedicated to transforming mental health care
  • The opportunity to make a real-world impact, building cutting-edge AI systems and real-time communication platforms that improve lives every day

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Executive Operations Integrator
description:
Role: Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics: We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry/salon space.

Contract: Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate: $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start: Immediately


Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.


What You'll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:


Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.


System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.


Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.


Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.


Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.


What You Should Have

Must-haves:

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling/inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.


Technology Specifications:

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.


Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who:

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what's not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

Como se destacar no processo?

Pesquise sobre a gente, traga suas perguntas e ideias. Chegue preparado para mostrar quem você é e dar o seu melhor. Quer uma dica? Esses são os nossos valores e eles guiam tudo o que fazemos aqui:

Saber aprender: Estamos sempre abertos ao novo. O aprendizado e a inovação andam juntos.

Pessoas importam: Pessoas são únicas. Por isso, cuidamos com atenção de cada uma delas, respeitando suas individualidades e escolhas.

Foco no cliente: É para o cliente que construímos nossas soluções com dedicação, excelência e respeito.

Talentos fortalecem times: É fundamental respeitar a diversidade de ideias e saber cooperar entre times para construir algo maior.

Ética sempre: Acreditamos que ética cabe em todos os lugares, a qualquer hora e em todas as situações.

title: Analista de suporte pleno - condomínios
description:
Analista de Suporte Pleno

  • Experiência prévia em atendimento técnico ou suporte ao cliente, preferencialmente em ambientes de alta demanda;

  • Domínio da ferramenta Zendesk (ou plataformas similares de gestão de tickets);

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com foco em clareza e empatia no atendimento;

  • Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas de forma ágil e estruturada;

  • Organização e gestão de tempo para lidar com múltiplos atendimentos simultaneamente;

  • Ensino técnico ou superior (cursando ou completo) em áreas como Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, ou correlatas;

  • Desejável conhecimento básico em redes, sistemas operacionais e ferramentas de acesso remoto;

  • Disponibilidade para trabalho em regime híbrido (3x na semana presencial).

Fazendo parte do time, você terá SuperBenefícios como:

  • Flexibilidade de horário:  

Podemos sempre nos adaptar às mudanças do dia a dia, o importante mesmo é sempre alcançar o objetivo.

  • Ajuda de custo para os dias em home office:

A gente dá o suporte necessário para que você possa trabalhar no conforto do seu lar, em dias de home office.

Transformar o mundo dá uma fome, né?! E é claro que o nosso recheado VA e VR não podem ficar de fora dessa missão.

A saúde sempre em primeiro lugar, para você e seus dependentes.

Se tornar mãe ou pai é algo espetacular, e queremos participar deste grande momento com você. Por isso, além do auxílio creche, temos também licença-parental (maternidade e paternidade) estendida.

Parceria com o Gympass e auxílio farmácia.

Temos parcerias com escolas e universidades e oferecemos treinamentos EaD gratuitos.

title: Consultor(a) de implantação (são paulo e região) - contábil
description:
Nosso propósito é transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas, e pode ser o seu também!

Somos uma GovTech pioneira no desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes em nuvem para gestão pública no Brasil, focados na construção de cidades inteligentes. Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Hoje, atuamos diariamente para transformar e descomplicar a gestão pública através do que há de melhor na tecnologia, com uma solução única e inteligente para gestão das cidades, seja na Contabilidade, na Saúde, na Educação, ou em mais de uma dezena de áreas.
A IPM é formada por mais de 600 pessoas apaixonadas pela inovação e transformação digital das cidades. Somos movidos por grandes desafios e pelo nosso impacto, e temos um sonho maior ainda: transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas através do melhor da tecnologia.

Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Nos últimos anos, conquistamos diversos prêmios e certificações da consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW). Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos como um dos 5 melhores times de RH do Brasil; em 2023, figuramos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar pela segunda vez no ranking Mulher e pela primeira vez no ranking LGBTI+; e em 2024, recebemos pela 5ª vez consecutiva a certificação de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar. Além disso, em 2024, alcançamos o 1º lugar nacional no Prêmio Connected Smart Cities, sendo premiados pela melhor solução para cidades inteligentes no Brasil.
Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer. ♥

Venha construir o futuro da gestão pública na IPM!

Nessa vaga, seu desafio será:

  • Implementar o Sistema Contábil da IPM nos órgãos públicos municipais, seguindo as regras de negócio e as necessidades do cliente, incluindo rotinas e áreas como: Planejamento e Orçamento, Gestão
  • Patrimonial e Contábil, Gestão Financeira, Prestação de Contas, e Controle Interno;
  • Analisar os processos e as funcionalidades do sistema, identificando melhoria e adequações;
  • Parametrizar o sistema conforme os requisitos levantados, garantindo a qualidade e a segurança dos dados;
  • Ministrar treinamentos aos usuários do sistema, orientando sobre as operações e as funcionalidades disponíveis;
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, solucionando problemas e esclarecendo dúvidas.

Requisitos:

Para essa posição, você vai precisar de:

  • Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração, Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em legislação e normas públicas aplicáveis a área de atuação (Contabilidade Pública), com rotinas como Planejamento e Orçamento, Gestão Patrimonial e Contábil, Gestão Financeira,
    Prestação de Contas, e Controle Interno;
  • Conhecimento em software de gestão orçamentária, contábil, e financeira;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.

Benefícios

Benefícios que nosso time mais gosta:

  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação (R$35,00 por dia de trabalho, em torno de R$735 ao mês) no cartão de benefícios flexível Caju;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Gympass - acesso livre a mais de 50 mil academias pelo Brasil;
  • Psicologia Viva - plano de telepsicologia com uma consulta com psicólogo por mês sem custo
  • Conexa Saúde - plataforma completa de telemecidina, com uma consulta de pronto atendimento por mês sem custo;
  • IPM Birthday - R$150,00 no Caju no mês do seu aniversário, para tornar o seu dia ainda mais especial;
  • IPM Indica - indicou um profissional, ele(a) passou no processo seletivo e ficou, pelo menos, 2 semanas na empresa, você recebe o valor de R$ 500,00 de bonificação pela indicação;
  • Convênio para plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Convênio para plano odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Rede de convênios para descontos, incluindo farmácias;
  • Comemoração de datas festivas de cada mês - Janeiro Branco, CarnaFriday, Festa Junina, dentre outros;
  • Dress code flexível - na nossa Sede e Centro de Tecnologia, você pode vir trabalhar de bermuda e camiseta;
  • Excelente cultura organizacional - somos reconhecidos como um excelente lugar para trabalhar pela consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW), uma das 25 melhores empresas do Brasil para mulheres;
  • Plano de cargos e salários - aqui você tem a oportunidade real de crescer, e é reconhecido e valorizado pelo seu trabalho e desenvolvimento;

E muito mais! Dia da Fruta, bicicletário, reconhecimento por conquistas individuais e de time, atuação na empresa líder em tecnologia para gestão pública...
Importante: Todas as nossas posições são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD). Se os seus conhecimentos forem adequados à vaga, é tudo o que importa. Na IPM, nós abraçamos a diversidade e contratamos pessoas com capacidade e vontade de transformar, de construir um futuro melhor para a sociedade, independente de qual seja a sua idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou formação. Seu perfil e valores casam com os nossos? Então venha fazer parte!
